rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-widest for section titles. Chivo medium weight.
rules.data_readouts: JetBrains Mono exclusively for coordinates, dates, scores, areas, and IDs.
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans text-sm to text-xs for dense information.
rules.labels: Tiny (text-[10px]), uppercase, tracking-wider, text-slate-400 for structural labels.

layouts.overall: Map is absolute full-screen hero element. UI panels are collapsible absolute overlays over the map.
layouts.left_panel: w-80 or w-96, docked left. Contains AOI list, search form, layer toggles.
layouts.right_panel: w-80 or w-96, docked right. Contains observations, change events, dashboard stats, event detail.
layouts.bottom_timeline: h-24 docked at bottom. Play/pause controls, observation markers distributed by month.
layouts.spacing: Ultra-dense. p-2 to p-4 maximum inner padding. Use 1px borders to separate rows instead of whitespace.
layouts.borders: Square corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Grid borders (border-collapse) for tabular data.

components.buttons: Flat, 1px solid border, no radius, subtle inner glow on hover. Tactical accent color for primary actions.
components.panels: Solid bg-black/95 or bg-[#09090B]/95. NO glassmorphism blurring (backdrop-blur) as it distorts underlying map data. Pure solid dark surfaces.
components.inputs: Flat, border-b only or sharp 1px border. Focus state turns border to tactical cyan.
components.job_progress: Minimal step tracker with monospace status labels (e.g., [SEARCHING], [DOWNLOADING], [DETECTING]).
components.change_event_card: Thumbnail on left, dense monospace stats on right (Area, Score, Conf). Border-left accent color based on confidence level.

motion.data_updates: Flicker/glitch effect for new incoming intelligence data.
motion.hover: Instant highlight, no soft fading. Sharp and precise.

visual_enhancers.scanlines: Subtle repeating-linear-gradient scanline overlay on empty states or loaders.
visual_enhancers.crosshairs: Use custom crosshair cursor over the map.
visual_enhancers.corner_brackets: Use L-shaped SVG brackets for framing important images (before/after thumbnails).

media.map: OpenLayers with a dark-themed base map underneath satellite imagery.

background_map.description: Dark abstract map texture for placeholder map loading state

satellite_demo.description: Aerial satellite view for before/after demo panel

satellite_night.description: Earth at night for global context

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards. Avoid gray-on-gray for readable text.
accessibility.focus: High contrast cyan outlines for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React app using Shadcn UI (customize components to remove borders radius and soften shadows).
Make the OpenLayers map cover the entire viewport absolute inset-0.
Layer the left panel, right panel, and bottom timeline as fixed/absolute overlays above the map (z-index 10).
Use solid dark colors for overlays (bg-zinc-950). Do not use backdrop-blur for overlays to prevent map distortion.
For tabular data and cards, use JetBrains Mono to mimic a terminal or tactical HUD.
Render a prominent DEMO DATA badge at the top center if CDSE credentials aren't active.
Implement the UI exclusively with .js/.jsx, no TypeScript.
DO NOT use generic Inter/Roboto fonts for headings. Use Chivo.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use absolute positioning and dense panel architecture.
Use 1px borders and sharp edges. Remove default rounding from Shadcn components.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for text containers over maps.
Do not use transition-all. Be specific.
Never center-align the main App container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
